title: Helicopter Crash-Hospital-Highway Crash-Train Tracks.
content: I think I had a mall world experience last week. I am just learning of dreamworld today. It started in a house, I heard a helicopter overhead and had this sinking feeling that it would crash. I could clearly see outside the window a 3-5 story rectangular brick building with trees kind of in the way, somewhat blocking the sky. I seen the helicopter coming down, it missed the landing on top of the building, I ran outside and seen it crash in the backyard. I ran outside to help, the person that came out of it was my mother. I take her to the hospital, I don’t remember the trip there just arriving and seeing the big circular white building open in the middle as we are coming (very similar to images on this sub). I don’t remember what happened in between I just remember being in the car. I recall leaving the hospital with my fiancée neither of us are driving. The car from what I remember seemed to be a silver or black Chevrolet Impala. I don’t remember any of the trip but I do remember feeling uneasy coming up on the highway. The roads were twisty and we were riding up a tall curvy winding bridge. We make it to the top of this bridge and we flew over the guard rail. We fell for a while, not insanely long but like realistically long. I felt the force of us falling in my stomach. I see the train tracks and a train coming where we are falling. Then it’s blank, no impact. I then end up in a dirty alleyway on the outskirts of a city lifting up ruble (not related to the crash) to help a stuck cat. I realized what just happened and ran over to the train tracks to see the car completely mangled into a pole by the train track. My fiancée was standing outside the car wrapped in a medical blanket, the cops and ambulance where there but they were just looking at me. This dream happened the night before Halloween. I don’t remember very many details of the dream but hearing about the hospital, the winding roads, and the train tracks reminded me of this dream seeing pictures of the hospital and the road with the bridges on other post literally gave me a “that’s so raven” type of feeling lol. It’s weird cause I have crazy dreams and I don’t always write them down unless they leave me feeling stumped. I’ve also had dreams of me in a city suburb getting into a car accident in my Hyundai sonata, that dreamed led me to many other places after the wreck. First place it took me was a casino, but like a hotel lobby casino, very generic red and green carpets and tons of people, waiters walking around with circular sample trays, white button ups and black bow ties, then a Walmart like a packed Walmart tons of people extremely vast like an infinite Walmart, from there it took take place in a giant apartment, multiple stories high , filled with tons of people, even people even people I know, they were people sitting on their porches talking to me from the 3rd-4th floor, people playing outside, pets running around like people absolutely everywhere and it was dark outside. I actually wrecked my car a couple weeks after this
